Description.SourceString: 早雾说，晚上好。
Description.LocalizedString: Sakiri says, "Good evening."

Description.SourceString: 工作日的早晨应该听进行曲。
Description.LocalizedString: Weekday mornings call for a good march to get you going.

Description.SourceString: 小水仙女士负责夜间安全……意思是可爱的称呼和睡得太死只能选一个。
Description.LocalizedString: Daff is in charge of night security… which means I have to choose between a cute nickname and sleeping like the dead.

Description.SourceString: 所以这个字怎么念？
Description.LocalizedString: So how do you say this word again?

Description.SourceString: 哪里？那里。哪里是哪里？那里就是那里啊。
Description.LocalizedString: Where? There. Where is where? There is there, of course.

Description.SourceString: 换个名字的话，可以不用补考吗？
Description.LocalizedString: If I change my name, can I skip the makeup exam?

Description.SourceString: 亚军什么的……才不要呢！
Description.LocalizedString: Second place? No way!

Description.SourceString: 埃德嘉知道的事情很多，但是埃德减不知道哦。
Description.LocalizedString: Edgar knows a lot of things, but ragdE doesn't know a thing!

Description.SourceString: 一个白藏正在上班，另一个白藏就去休假吧。
Description.LocalizedString: One Baicang is on duty, so the other Baicang should take a vacation.

Description.SourceString: 请不要在哈索尔小姐面前哭泣，会被无视的。
Description.LocalizedString: Please don't cry in front of Hathor. She'll just ignore you.

Description.SourceString: 仔细寻觅中 偶遇珍品心欢喜 原来是假货
Description.LocalizedString: Carefully seeking, my heart leaps at a treasure's gleam—alas, it's but a fake.

Description.SourceString: 总觉得阿德勒先生怎么称呼都可以……
Description.LocalizedString: I feel like Adler can be addressed in any way…

Description.SourceString: 「她」喜欢的东西，我也会喜欢的。
Description.LocalizedString: I'll come to like anything she likes too.

Description.SourceString: 明明应该是「九九归一」，但是尊贵的九原小姐坚持「十」才是完美的数字。
Description.LocalizedString: It should be "all nines return to one," but the noble Jiuyuan insists that "ten" is the perfect number.

Description.SourceString: 今日的明音也有好好工作吗？
Description.LocalizedString: Did Akane work hard today as well?

Description.SourceString: TaygeTaygeTaygeTaygeTaygeTaygeTaygedo.
Description.LocalizedString: TaygeTaygeTaygeTaygeTaygeTaygeTaygedo.

Description.SourceString: 不会发光的星星，好像有点可惜。
Description.LocalizedString: A star that doesn't shine — such a pity.

Description.SourceString: 花无百日红。
Description.LocalizedString: No flower blooms forever.

Description.SourceString: 戴面罩的，也不一定都是坏人嘛。
Description.LocalizedString: Not everyone behind a mask is a bad guy.

Description.SourceString: 伪红只会在呗果里出没，现实里没有伪红，别试着去找她。
Description.LocalizedString: Faeku only shows up on Bagel. She isn't real. Don't bother looking for her.

Description.SourceString: 在你面前的，是伊波恩最凶狠的维修师，新概念海獭，神秘语言使用者，无法跨栏之物……
Description.LocalizedString: Meet Eibon's fiercest Restorer: a cutting-edge sea otter who speaks in cryptic tongues and couldn't clear a fence if he tried.

Description.SourceString:
Q³节日限定睡衣，很适合和朋友一起听睡前故事。
「女巫有一片南瓜地，里面有会魔法的干干净净的南瓜，和不会魔法的麻麻赖赖的南瓜。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Q³ holiday limited edition pajamas, perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"A witch had a pumpkin field with squeaky clean magical pumpkins, and scruffy non-magical pumpkins."

Description.SourceString:
Q³节日限定睡衣，很适合和朋友一起听睡前故事。
「玛丽有只小黑猫，耳朵是母亲的，身体是父亲的，兄弟姐妹是它的四肢，无论玛丽走到哪里，它总是跟着跑。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Q³ holiday limited edition pajamas, perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"Mary had a little black cat, with ears from her mother, a body from her father, and siblings as its limbs. Wherever Mary went, it would always follow along."

Description.SourceString:
Q³节日限定睡衣，很适合和朋友一起听睡前故事。
「从前在森林里有一只孤单的小灰狼，为了交到朋友，它带上了丝绒做的红斗篷。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Q³ holiday limited edition pajamas, perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"Once upon a time, there was a lonely little gray wolf in the forest who donned a velvet red cape, hoping to make friends."

Description.SourceString:
一套设计独特的格斗服。娜娜莉为此特地报名了格斗训练班。
「什么时候去上训练课？呃……下次一定！」
Description.LocalizedString:
A fighting outfit with a unique design. Nanally specifically enrolled in a combat training class for this.
"When am I going to attend the training sessions? Uh… Next time for sure!"

Description.SourceString:
学院风格服装，兼顾美观与舒适。袖标由娜娜莉自行制作，本人对此颇为满意。
「咳咳，柯林斯有柯林斯的风纪！」
Description.LocalizedString:
School uniform style clothing that balances both beauty and comfort. The armband was handmade by Nanally herself, and she's quite satisfied with it.
"Ahem, Colucci has its own standards of discipline!"

Description.SourceString:
薄荷的居家服装。简单的服饰，彰显居家的随性与放松。
「休息日，当然要宅在家里睡大觉！」
Description.LocalizedString:
Mint's loungewear. Simple clothing that showcases the carefree and relaxed spirit of being a homebody.
"There's nothing better than staying home and sleeping in on a day off!"

Description.SourceString:
九原的居家服装。看似简单的衣装，也经由设计师精心设计。
「吸气……呼气……舒展身体，让心情平静……」
Description.LocalizedString:
Jiuyuan's loungewear. Though it looks simple, this outfit was carefully tailored by a designer.
"Breathe in… breathe out… stretch your body, let your mind find peace…"

Description.SourceString:
娜娜莉的居家服装。在简单衣裙的基础上添加了富有巧思的装饰。
「正所谓如虎添翼，老虎和翅膀就是绝配！」
Description.LocalizedString:
Nanally's loungewear. Thoughtful decorations have been added to a simple dress.
"Ever heard of 'adding wings to a tiger'? Tigers and wings are a perfect combo!"

Description.SourceString:
俏皮又不失帅气的着装，层叠的衣衫和亮眼的配饰，尽显随性自由。
「一流的猎人，也该有一流的衣品~」
Description.LocalizedString:
Playful yet stylish attire with layers and eye-catching accessories, showcasing a carefree personality.
"A first-rate hunter should have first-rate fashion sense too!"

Description.SourceString: 轻便合身、简洁利落，永不出错的穿搭，帮助你轻松融入人群。
Description.LocalizedString: Light and fitted, clean and sharp styling that never goes wrong, helping you blend into crowds with ease.

Description.SourceString: 拘留所统一服装，版型合身、面料舒适、颜色亮眼，要是平常也能穿的话……
Description.LocalizedString: Standard detention center uniform with a well-fitted cut, comfortable fabric, and bright colors. If only I could wear it normally…

Description.SourceString:
学院风格着装，低调配色辅以经典花纹，彰显精致的优等生气质。
「明天的联谊会，要一起去吗？」
Description.LocalizedString:
Preppy academic attire with understated colors complemented by classic patterns, showcasing the refined aura of an honor student.
"Want to attend tomorrow's mixer together?"

Description.SourceString: 充满童趣的背带裤套装，独特的印花图案与不对称设计，个性十足。就算身上溅到颜料，也会被当作印花的一部分。
Description.LocalizedString: A playful overalls set full of childlike charm, featuring unique printed patterns and an asymmetrical design with loads of personality. Even if you get paint splattered on it, it'll just look like part of the print.

Description.SourceString: 极具剪裁设计的赛车服，就像身边伙伴一样，无可替代。
Description.LocalizedString: A sharply tailored racing suit, as irreplaceable as the partner at your side.

Description.SourceString:
法帝娅的居家服装。比起穿着舒适度，她更希望用衣装点缀夜色。
「黑夜会替我们保守秘密。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Fadia's loungewear. Rather than prioritizing comfort, she prefers to use clothing to complement the night.
"The darkness will keep our secrets."

Description.SourceString:
俏皮又不失帅气的着装，层叠的衣衫和亮眼的配饰，尽显随性自由。
「一流的猎人，也该有一流的衣品~」

"A first-rate hunter should have first-rate fashion sense too!"

「明天的联谊会，要一起去吗？」

"Want to attend tomorrow's mixer together?"

Description.LocalizedString: A sharply tailored racing suit, as irreplaceable as the partner at your side.

Description.SourceString:
以鬼兰花为主题的高级定制套装，这套在影楼非常容易出效果。
不过从价格角度来考虑的话，大概只有在伊波恩开店前、资金还充裕的那时候才有商量余地。
Description.LocalizedString: A custom couture outfit themed after the Ghost Orchid, purchased when Hotori still had plenty of startup funds after opening her shop.As for later… even after selling her car, she never once considered parting with this piece. She must really love it.

Description.SourceString:
浔的居家服装。宽松轻便的打扮，躲闲时还是舒服最重要。
「惊鹿一声响。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Hotori's loungewear. Comfortable and lightweight—when lying around the house, comfort is paramount.
"Soft birdsong in the morning."

Description.SourceString: 「好苗子通通收入柯林斯家族！」
Description.LocalizedString: "All promising talent belongs to The Coluccis!"

Description.SourceString: 「可以用塔吉多看心猎铁骑吗？」
Description.LocalizedString: "Can I watch Kokoro Rider on Taygedo?"

Description.SourceString: 浔自费购入的衣装，用以改善小水仙沉闷的衣柜，达芙蒂尔为此新买了五个不同的眼罩用来搭配它。
Description.LocalizedString: Hotori personally purchased this outfit to brighten up Daff's rather dull wardrobe. In response, Daffodill bought five different eye patches just to match it.

Description.SourceString:
小吱的居家服装。柔软亲肤的面料，休假时间就该舒舒服服地待在家里啊。
「虽然明天也不出门，但请……请出太阳吧！」
Description.LocalizedString:
Chiz's loungewear. Soft, skin-friendly material—staying at home is the right way to spend a day off.
"I'm not going out tomorrow either, but… I hope the sun still comes out!"

Description.SourceString:
粉爪银行某年年会的表演着装，彼时的乔望尼先生正异常沉迷这种黑白色生物。
「我、我们银行是要和胖达火锅联名吗……」
Description.LocalizedString:
Performance outfit from Pink Paws Bank's annual annual gala. At the time, Mr. Giovanni had developed an unusual fascination with a particular black-and-white animal 
"Are we… are we partnering with Panda Hotpot now?"

Description.SourceString:
颓废华丽的盛装，适合在出席古堡晚宴时穿着。
「夜空倾覆而下，浸透庭园里的玫瑰。多年之后，她们仍静默地绽放，而故事的后文终究无人知晓。」
Description.LocalizedString:
A decadent, ornate formal dress, perfect for a castle banquet.
"The night sky poured over the garden, soaking its roses in muted darkness. Years later, those flowers still bloom in silence, and the rest of the story has faded into shadow."

Description.SourceString:
就像夜与昼一样，这世上黑白分明的东西有很多：浓缩咖啡与拿铁咖啡，奶牛猫与牛奶猫，钢琴的黑键与白键，日常打扮的安魂曲和偶尔换上白裙子出门的安魂曲。
「白裙子，很好看。但是，容易弄脏……」
Description.LocalizedString:
Like night and day, some things in this world are simply black and white: espresso and latte, tuxedo cats and white cats, piano keys, Lacrimosa's everyday outfit, and the white dress she wears only once in a while.
"White dresses are pretty. But… they get dirty so easily."

Description.SourceString: 幸福的降临或许总是毫无章法，宛如一场横冲直撞的「硬着陆」。就像昭示幸福来临的蝙蝠飞入窗棂时，也总伴着清脆的巨响和散落一地的碎玻璃那样。
Description.LocalizedString: Happiness sometimes arrives without rhyme or reason, like a reckless hard landing. Just as the bat that foretells good fortune flies through the window lattice, it always comes with a crisp crash and shattered glass strewn across the floor.

Description.SourceString:
安魂曲的居家服装。布料柔软舒适，支持随时随地倒头就睡。
「一只蝙蝠……两只蝙蝠……三……呼……」
Description.LocalizedString:
Lacrimosa's loungewear. Made of soft, cozy fabric that lets you fall asleep anytime, anywhere.
"One bat… two bats… three… zzz…"

Description.SourceString: 闪耀之物往往很沉重。今天上班路上总觉得比往日飞得更累，或许不是安魂曲的错觉。
Description.LocalizedString: Things that shine are often heavy. Lacrimosa feels unusually tired flying to work today. Maybe it isn't just her imagination.

Description.SourceString: 即使是休息日，也不能松懈锻炼！
Description.LocalizedString: Even on days off, training never stops!

Description.SourceString: 休闲街头风格着装，简易单品与独特的配饰碰撞，亦能彰显个性。
Description.LocalizedString: A casual streetwear look that pairs simple pieces with bold accessories to express true individuality.

Description.SourceString: 「泡芙？……番茄酱泡芙，可以。」
Description.LocalizedString: Cream puffs? …Ketchup cream puffs? Sure, why not.

Description.SourceString: 柔软无害的生物，因为肚子太圆四肢无法碰到地面……你刚刚言语攻击了一只扭扭。
Description.LocalizedString: A soft, harmless little creature with a belly so round its feet can't touch the ground… Congratulations, you just roasted a Twisty.

Description.SourceString: 如果呗果能让你今天开心就太好啦。
Description.LocalizedString: All Bagel wants to do is to make you say yay!

Description.LocalizedString: Wanna have a taste of Fuzzies?

Description.SourceString:
扣好最后一粒纽扣，整理好衣领。
初次启程的人总要先学会这些。
Description.LocalizedString:
Fasten the last button, straighten the collar.
Those setting out for the first time must learn such things before all else.

Description.SourceString: 风会记住剑士的痕迹。
Description.LocalizedString: The wind shall remember the swordsman's path.

Description.SourceString: 荣光加冕，长夜有明。
Description.LocalizedString: Crowned in glory, the long night finds its light.

Description.SourceString:
扣好最后一粒纽扣，整理好衣领。
初次启程的人总要先学会这些。
Description.LocalizedString:
Fasten the last button, straighten the collar.
Those setting out for the first time must learn such things before all else.

Description.SourceString: 风会记住剑士的痕迹。
Description.LocalizedString: The wind shall remember the swordsman's path.

Description.SourceString: 荣光加冕，长夜有明。
Description.LocalizedString: Crowned in glory, the long night finds its light.

Description.SourceString: 万千风暴向心口收束，猎龙之人将踏上她的征途。
Description.LocalizedString: Countless storms gather in her heart, and the dragonhunter sets forth on her quest.

Description.SourceString:
"昭示着好胜心的专业竞赛泳装。海滨似乎总有让人变得坦率的魔力，又或者在水中破开浪潮的畅快感也推了一把。
「在享受夏日这件事上也要全力以赴。」"
Description.LocalizedString:
A pro-grade racing swimsuit that reveals her competitive spirit. The beach has a way of drawing out one's true self—or perhaps that is simply the thrill of cutting through the waves.
"Go all out—even when you’re enjoying summer."

Description.SourceString:
让人联想到青春感的学院风穿搭。据说每个人在这段时期都会逃避和追逐阴影中的那个自己……即使没有也会想办法找一个出来。
「不要随便用这种蠢透了的方式来解读……唉，算了。」
Description.LocalizedString:
A neat, preppy outfit with the fresh charm of campus life. They say youth is spent either fleeing from one's inner shadow or chasing after it… and even those without a shadow will find a way to cast one.
"Don't read something that ridiculous into it… Ugh, whatever."

Description.SourceString:
真红的居家服装，打定主意要在自己的收藏围绕下不受打扰地度过一阵悠闲时光时的打扮。龙的决心不容挑战。
「……不行。今天已经决定了，无论如何都不出门。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Shinku's loungewear for quiet days spent idling undisturbed among her treasures. Once a dragon has made up her mind, no force can shake her resolve.
"…No. I've already decided. I'm not going out today, no matter what."

Description.SourceString: 真红低着头，试图在人群中隐去身影一一毕竟，只要没人靠近，就不会有人受伤，对吧?
Description.LocalizedString: Shinku kept her head lowered, trying to vanish into the crowd. After all, if no one came close, then no one would get hurt… right?

Description.SourceString: 躲在花花绿绿的梦境里，注视这个漫长的夏天。
Description.LocalizedString: Hidden within a bright and colorful dreamscape, watching the long summer drift by.

Description.SourceString: 月亮坠落了一千次。只有一千次而已吗？
Description.LocalizedString: The moon has fallen a thousand times. Has it truly been only a thousand?

Description.SourceString: 术法的火花在指尖跳动，而伊洛伊还在构想梦的第一页。
Description.LocalizedString: Arcane sparks dance at her fingertips, while Iroi writes the first page of a dream yet unfinished.

Description.SourceString: 吟唱未停，梦的边界悄悄延展一寸。
Description.LocalizedString: The chant goes on, and the edge of the dream quietly stretches another inch.

Description.SourceString:
她将群星编入梦境。
一片宇宙的重量，对于睡着的伊洛伊来说刚刚好。
Description.LocalizedString:
She weaves the stars into the dreamscape.
As Iroi sleeps, the weight of a universe rests lightly upon her.

Description.SourceString: 跑起来的话，自由的气味会比脚步先到哦。
Description.LocalizedString: Run, and the scent of freedom will reach the road before your footsteps.

Description.SourceString: 从第一片落叶开始，到最后一道足迹结束，追猎从未停歇。
Description.LocalizedString: From the first fallen leaf to the final footprint, the hunt never ceases.

Description.SourceString: 身似幽火，面朝荒野，风的女儿理应无拘无束。
Description.LocalizedString: Like a ghostflame before the wilds, the daughter of the wind was born to roam free and unbound.

Description.SourceString: 长诗终于翻到了最后一页，嗯……猜猜故事有没有走到结局。
Description.LocalizedString: The long poem has at last turned to its final page. Hmm… I wonder if the story has truly come to an end.

Description.SourceString: 一一得一，二二得四。所以现在站在你面前的是四个伊洛伊。
Description.LocalizedString: One Oneiroi is one. Two Oneirois are two. As for two Twoirois? That makes a Fouriroi.
